text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Everyone gets this wild gleam in their eyes when it comes to racing! It was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I ain't gonna lose next time either!!
Right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that's true, but still!
Her eyes are the deadest of anyone's, though!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you compare flashiness to power consumption, those guys are
dishwashers, while I'm just an electric toothbrush!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Damn it, what the hell is the difference?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! Could they be in a...
series circuit?!
After that, I had to stop Gold Ship with all my might as she tried to set off on a journey to become a series circuit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now that that's settled, next I'll pop in some contacts fitted with LED lights and shine like crazy—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No, on second thought, maybe quantum stealth works too?
Though shooting beams from my eyes would be classic and cool too...
Afterward, I was taken to an eye clinic, but since no such contact lenses existed, I gave up.
